svg.title: Accelerometer direction to LED matrix visualisation
svg.desc: Four 8 by 8 LED matrices generated from the firmware pixel threshold: positive X lights upper rows, negative X lights lower rows, positive Y lights left columns, negative Y lights right columns. This is a synthetic diagram, not a photograph of hardware.
svg.text: Illustrative first frame (no hysteresis history) · 8 × 8 logical bitmap
Based on score = (3.5 − row)·dirX + (bitIndex − 3.5)·dirY; bitmap bit 7 is the leftmost logical pixel.
